messages:
sara (AM): Hey team — ACME POC kickoff tomorrow. Need final alignment on sandbox access, redaction requirements, and success criteria. They expect to upload a ~2GB sample set (invoices + chat transcripts). Can we confirm allowed ingestion patterns and who owns redaction?

devin (SE): We can accept: signed S3 upload (preferred), temporary SFTP, or assume-role access to their bucket for a short transform job. Signed URLs minimize IAM scope.

anita (Privacy): Redaction rules from privacy: strip names, emails, phone numbers, SSNs, account numbers, and full credit card numbers. Keep numeric fields needed for evaluation (totals, dates) but mask account IDs beyond last 4. Customer must sign off if they want us to process raw PII.

ryan (Eng): Implementation options:
1) Customer-run redaction: they upload sanitized sample to s3://acme-poc-sanitized/ — simplest for compliance.
2) Customer uploads raw to their bucket and grants us a short-lived assume-role. We run a transform lambda/worker, write sanitized copy to our sandbox bucket, then delete raw. Lifecycle: raw -> transform -> sanitized -> delete (raw) after transform. Default retention for sanitized copy can be 7 days unless they request longer.

paul (Solutions): Proposed success criteria (for the POC):
- Functional: invoice extraction macro accuracy >= 75% top-1 on the labelled eval set we provide.
- Performance: chat end-to-end median latency < 600 ms for typical prompt size on dedicated small pool.
- Ops: no auth failures during 5000 request test, and cost estimate within budget (we'll give a per-100k-token projection).
Deliverables: labelled eval set (we provide template), prompt library, demo scenario.

sara (AM): Security questionnaire question 12: "do you store unredacted customer data?" Need a short plain-language answer for the SQA.

anita (Privacy): Short answer: we do not retain unredacted customer data in hosted/sandbox POCs. If raw ingest is used, raw copies are only used for the transient transform job and removed immediately per deletion policy; sanitized copies are retained for the POC duration. Provide linked SOP and deletion logs on request.

devin (SE): Operational notes for the customer: please provide either
- a signed upload URL to s3://acme-poc-uploads/ (we will validate checksum), or
- an IAM role ARN for sts:AssumeRole with an explicit principal and a maximum session TTL of 1 hour.
If you choose assume-role, include a bucket policy that only allows PutObject from the role and an explicit deny for GetObject by other principals.

ryan (Eng): Minimal config example (transform job assumes role, writes sanitized copy):
```
# transform job pseudocode
assume_role('arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acme-poc-transform')
download('s3://acme-poc-raw/invoices.tar.gz')
run_redaction_script()
upload('s3://redwood-sandbox/acme/sanitized/invoices.tar.gz')
delete('s3://acme-poc-raw/invoices.tar.gz')
```
And sample redaction regexes we use: 
```
s/\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/[REDACTED_SSN]/g
s/\b\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}\b/[REDACTED_CC]/g
s/\b[\w.-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}\b/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g
```
We will supply an initial redaction script the customer can run locally.

paul (Solutions): Timeline idea: 2-week POC.
- Day 0: agreement + security checklist items submitted.
- Day 1-3: data ingest + redaction + labeled evals exchanged.
- Day 4-10: integration and prompt tuning, run batch evals.
- Day 11-13: customer validation + final tweaks.
- Day 14: demo + handoff + cost projection.
Owners: sara (AM) customer comms, devin (SE) integration, anita (Privacy) SCO/SQA responses, ryan (Eng) infra.

sara (AM): Customer also asked about encryption at rest and key management. They have a KMS requirement.

ryan (Eng): We support CMEK for sandbox buckets. If they want to bring their own key, we will need key policy that permits the Redood account principal to use Encrypt/Decrypt for the sandbox bucket. If BYOK is not possible, we can default to our managed keys and provide audit logs.

devin (SE): Pricing question from customer: does the POC incur token charges? We typically cover small POCs in-hosted for evaluation; if they want dedicated reserved capacity during the POC we need to quote a short-term commitment. I can draft a one-page POC SOW with optional dedicated tier pricing.

anita (Privacy): Also ask them to sign a short DPA addendum for processing PII in the POC. I'll attach a template after this thread.

infra-bot: Role created: arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/acme-poc-transform (ephemeral, TTL 3600s) :rocket:

sara (AM): OK — next steps I will: (1) send the redaction script and SQA language to the customer, (2) request their preferred upload method and KMS choice, (3) share the proposed success criteria and 2-week timeline. Devin please prepare the SOW draft for dedicated pricing option. Anita please attach the DPA template. Ryan will prepare the assume-role flow doc.

devin (SE): Got it, I'll have the SOW draft by EOD and wireframe of the eval harness.

anita (Privacy): I'll drop the DPA and short SQA responses by tomorrow morning.

ryan (Eng): I'll upload the assume-role runbook to the internal repo and ping the customer with role lifecycle details.

paul (Solutions): I'll craft the short labelled-eval template and sample prompts (invoice extraction, line-item QA).

sara (AM): Great. I'll update the customer and schedule a 30m technical onboarding tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
